fields.description: Bounded progression counter; load path rejects values >= 12 and falls back to ROM defaults. Copied to gameplay RAM on successful load.
fields.evidence: FUN_080006b0 checks *_DAT_080006e4 < 0xc then copies word0 to puRam08000718; FUN_08000500 loads it from EEPROM base 0 and FUN_080003c4 stores it to banks 0/0x200.
fields.name: progress_counter

fields.description: Persistent gameplay state word 1; block-copied from the EEPROM read buffer to gameplay RAM by the load routine and covered by the additive checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_080006b0 copies save words1-3 to puRam0800071c after FUN_08000500(0,_DAT_080006e4,4) succeeds; FUN_080003c4 writes them via FUN_08009f60.
fields.name: gameplay_state_1

fields.description: Mirror-bank copy of the progression counter (EEPROM bank at 0x200, file offset 0x1000). Written and verified in lockstep with the primary bank.
fields.evidence: FUN_080003c4 writes every entry twice: FUN_08009f60(param_1+uVar6) and FUN_08009f60(0x200+param_1+uVar6); FUN_08000500 reads back and compares both banks.
